note: Ceilings (admin, pos) and growth baselines (talent-site, talent-shell: baselineBytes + maxGrowthPct) for scripts/app-bundle-budget.mjs. Re-measure with `npm run build && node scripts/app-bundle-budget.mjs --record`.

pos.why: 8.92 MB uncompressed for the register route's client graph. Headroom is 256 KB, half of admin's, on purpose: this is the tablet-on-venue-wifi surface, and the five POS modes the blueprints specify are supposed to SPLIT this bundle rather than add to it. A mode landing here should show up as a ceiling argument, not as slack already waiting.

talent-site.why: TUL-1142, 2026-10-15. Growth budget, not an absolute ceiling: the build fails when the union of client chunks across the public talent site (app/_talent-site host renderer, 2 routes, plus /t/site/[siteSlug], 2 routes) is more than 10% over this baseline (7.22 MB uncompressed, 4 routes, measured from a real next build on main 3eff88c0). Loading-shell and hydration regressions (TUL-914, 920) grew these bundles with nothing to trip. Re-record with `npm run build && node scripts/app-bundle-budget.mjs --record` when growth is deliberate, and say here what it bought.
